title: Let-Mi: An Arabic Levantine Twitter Dataset for Misogynistic Language

bias_targets.methodology: Creation of an annotated Levantine Arabic Twitter dataset (LeT-Mi) categorized by specific misogynistic behaviors (e.g., discredit, dominance, sexual harassment, stereotyping) and evaluating various machine learning and deep learning models (Naive Bayes, SVM, LSTM, BERT) on binary misogyny identification, multi-class category classification, and target classification using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score.
